1.17.0+260921 (2026-09-24)

Turn off automatic guides (#159)

The first page of the guide now has a "do not show me guides automatically" option. Picking it closes the guide and stops guides opening on their own here and elsewhere in Deploy App. The info button still opens the guide when you want it.

Changelog

Features

  • honour the Deploy App guide opt-out (2c55260)
